interpretation: Minimize -Q+0.5*R. Q sums the arithmetic means of ORIGINAL integer-parsed native reviewer overall_score for accepted review-history decisions; institution-written final_score is not used. Unreviewed acceptance contributes zero Q. R counts actual review records, not reviewed papers. The explicit illustrative coefficient 0.5 expresses a review-work preference and is not empirically calibrated scientific value. Zero reviews, reject-all and all-accept remain legal. No hidden quality/fairness/novelty/promotion veto.
